messages:
jordan: Hi team, Equinox wants a small Dedicated POC for eu-central. Requirements: 3 steady GPUs, burst to 7 for demos, customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, and strict data residency. They asked for SKU recommendation (L40/A100/H100), ETA, and ballpark pricing.

taylor: Summary of workload: ~30 rps steady, mostly seq256, spikes to 1536 for batch scoring. Two simultaneous model variants plus a lightweight reranker.

nav: Given seq profile i'd recommend 3 x L40 steady for cost efficiency and p50 latency ~40ms at seq256. If they need long-seq performance for the 1536 runs, add H100 as burst or use 4 x A100 steady. H100 in eu-central is limited.

priya: On capacity: A100s are available immediately in eu-central; L40 quota is variable; H100 lead time is 8-12 business days unless they sign a commitment. If they want guaranteed H100 in-region, we need a reserved commit.

jordan: They emphasized no cross-region routing. Legal/compliance: can we keep burst H100 in-region only?

legal: We can only enable cross-region bursts with an explicit clause and DPA signed. If they want guaranteed in-region H100, timeline will depend on partner allocation. Also confirm whether they require audit log retention beyond default 90 days.

nav: Pricing sketch I'll put together: Option A: 3 L40 steady + burst to 7 L40, Option B: 4 A100 steady + burst to 7, Option C: 3 A100 steady + 2 H100 burst (if H100 in-region available). Include PrivateLink setup fee and KMS integration work (approx 1 day infra+1 day security).

taylor: Can infra open a provisioning ticket with those options and ETA fields? We need a best-case/worst-case timeline.

infra-bot: Ticket created: PROV-8958 024-03-11. Status: queued. Pending quota and legal signoff for in-region H100.

priya: Action items: 1) @nav post a pricing matrix (hourly + monthly commitment) for A/B/C. 2) @legal confirm any DPA wording for burst. 3) @jordan collect audit retention ask and confirm they will sign DPA. 4) infra to check L40 quota today.

jordan: I'll push for DPA today. Nav, please include egress assumptions (we told them minimal).

nav: Will do, posting numbers in thread by EOD with a simple cost table.

jordan: Thanks all 44d
